FREE BUS TRAVEL FOR WOMEN (VIDIYAL PAYANAM SCHEME) 
 
1. 
Gist of the Scheme 
Provides 100% free travel for women, transgender persons, and differently abled persons in all town/city ordinary fare state transport corporation (TNSTC/MTC) buses across Tamil Nadu. 
 
2. 
Objective 
To increase female labor force participation, enhance mobility for women workers and students, and save household transportation expenditure. 
 
3. 
Eligibility Criteria 
- All women residing in Tamil Nadu (no age limit, no income limit).
- Transgender individuals.
- Differently abled persons and one accompanying attendant.
 
4. 
Benefits Provided 
Unlimited zero-fare travel in ordinary white-board city/town town buses operated by State Transport Corporations.
 
5. 
Department 
Transport Department, Government of Tamil Nadu.
